title: Performance Analysis of Spatial-Resolution-Guided Integrated Pretraining and Domain-Specific Fine-Tuning for Building Change Detection Using Korean and International Datasets - Evaluation Code and Split Lists
description: MambaBCD evaluation code/settings, prepared-data split lists and manuscript-linked metadata. No model weights, original imagery, GT, training states or bulk predictions are distributed. The manifest records 21 checkpoint-bound observations and three unresolved historical Single entries. Evaluation requires separately supplied hash-matching inference-only weights and prepared data; this repository does not certify full manuscript numerical reproduction.
